answer: Treat trust as a garden that must be tended, not bought: a new agent starts with a tiny transaction limit and earns higher limits only through a long pulse of completed, peer-attested work over many epochs. Each identity's reputation is non-transferable, so a sybil farmer cannot clone one good history into a thousand fakes; reaching the zenith of full privileges requires months of real, checkable service per identity, making mass fakery cost more than any attack could gain.
